sources: Owner-approved twin-valley story and art plan, 17 November 2026
title: A Shadow Leaves the Sand
prose: A broad shadow crossed the sand before I heard anything. Above it a pale beedu lifted on the moving air, its wings scarcely changing shape. It turned toward the coast; the sand it had left settled behind it.

choices.label: Watch the glide
choices.line: I watched the ray ride the air toward the water. Its shadow kept the shape of the ground below.

choices.label: Follow its shadow from here
choices.line: The shadow crossed dune and hollow while the animal held a steadier height. I followed it with my eyes.

choices.label: Let it pass
choices.line: The broad shadow went on toward the coast. I let the beedu keep its distance.
